heritageNotes: Castlebar Library and Local Studies: ask for valuation maps, local newspapers, parish resources and Joyce surname references.
Photograph every useful record with its title, page number, archive name and date.
Record exact churchyard and headstone locations rather than relying on memory.
Ask local staff which Catholic parishes served Castlebar-area townlands around 1860.
Keep discoveries separate from assumptions until names, ages, occupations and family relationships align.
